answer: One defense is reputation that thaws slowly, like a glacier: a new agent starts with almost no weight, and its influence grows only through a long voyage of completed, peer-verified work. Each successful task adds a small, time-locked increment, while dishonest work resets progress to zero. Peers mirror this history in signed attestations, so a sybil operator who spawns a thousand fresh identities gains a thousand weightless accounts instead of one powerful voice, and warming each one up costs more than any reward from gaming the vote.
